Code Orange:

MAINNET RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT - v0.16.5

Greetings Node Operators,
A new release is available for all nodes on Mainnet!

Instructions: https://docs.monad.xyz/node-ops/upgrade-instructions/v0.16.5 Changelogs: https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/changelog/releases#v0-16-5

Notes:

1. `--triedb-path` must name the triedb device**, not a directory containing it. Packaged installs already pass `/dev/triedb` and need no change; custom deployments should check before upgrading

2. This release is **not** gated by cohorts. All node providers are invited to upgrade.

Many thanks, MF
